# FastAPI Task Dashboard Backend

Complete implementation with projects, tasks, status filtering, SQLite persistence, validation, and tests.

## Project Structure

```
task_dashboard/
├── requirements.txt
├── app/
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── main.py
│   ├── database.py
│   ├── models.py
│   ├── schemas.py
│   ├── crud.py
│   └── routers/
│       ├── __init__.py
│       ├── projects.py
│       └── tasks.py
└── tests/
    ├── __init__.py
    ├── conftest.py
    ├── test_projects.py
    └── test_tasks.py
```

---
